profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Developer with over 15 years of expertise building robust enterprise web applications from scratch and optimizing legacy systems for peak efficiency.
profile.summary:
Computer engineer, I love programming, developing systems and databases. Accomplished Senior Full-Stack .NET Developer with around 10 Years of extensive experience in Software Analysis, Design, Development, Data Modeling, Intranet, Extranet Applications and Integrating, Maintenance, Testing, Database Support into web applications, Production support and experience with all phases of SDLC.
Strongest technologies are: C#, ASP .Net, Sql Server, Oracle, Jquery, Javascript.

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Architected and developed "DoxViewer" from scratch using .NET 8 Core and Angular, engineering a decoupled micro-frontend architecture that enabled seamless iframe integration within third-party applications.
Led the performance optimization of "Navigator" (.NET MVC / AngularJS / SQL Server), significantly boosting responsiveness by restructuring the backend for fully asynchronous processing and implementing lazy-loading UI logic.
Direct the architecture, continuous support, and modernization of "FAL Portal" (.NET 8 / Angular), transforming it into a high-performance Single Page Application (SPA) using advanced routing and route guards for secure authentication and authorization.
Designed and delivered the "DUP" application from the ground up using ASP.NET MVC and AngularJS as a scalable Single Page Application.
Spearheaded the migration of the "DUP" platform to .NET 8 and Angular, successfully eliminating legacy security vulnerabilities while integrating Active Directory authorization and robust route-guard patterns to elevate both security and user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Angular · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · .NET Core · C#

positions.title: Software Developer .net Full Stack
positions.description: Working as a consultant being Visiant Health the client, it is an American Enterprise that provides IT services, most of his clients are in the medical insurance business and I was giving support to a few of them attending requirements from business analysts, those could be fixing a bug, adding some features or performance or making some reports

positions.title: Software developer .net full stack
positions.description:
I have been working there as an IT consultant being TV Azteca the client.
I started a new project that showed much information about sales, I was showing that information with animation, graphics and tables to make it easy understand the information using the following technologies: ASP. Net, C#, Oracle, JavaScript, Jquery, WebServices, Ajax, TFS

positions.title: Software Developer .net Full Stack
positions.description:
Grupo Salinas has several products being micronegocio one of them. Micronegocio is an enterprise of financial business, it provides loans to a group of people (most of them women) to help them to improve their own business such as different kind of stores and services. 
I  created different system pages which help executives to sell credits using the following technologies ASP. Net, C#, SQL Server, JavaScript, WCF, SmartClient, Telerik

positions.title: Software Developer .net Full Stack
positions.description:
SEP is a government institution regarding the public education of the entire nation. They have a project that consists to certify the capacity of the teachers, it has to be measured and the performance must be shown in a web page made in pascal with asp. Net. I was adding new modules to show this kind of information.
I  have been providing support and creating a system which shows information about professors using graphics to make it easy to understand the information, using the following technologies: ASP.Net, PHP, Pascal, SQL Server, Highcharts. Upgraded the Portable Universal Programmer software programmed in PASCAL
